messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

The top and sides of the shell are covered by a voluminous mass of dense shaggy curly brown wool-like fur that drapes over the rim of the shell.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "scaly tortoise head with pebbly scales and blunt beak-like snout", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body on an extended neck, facing right"}, {"looks_like": "small dark round eye with scaly eyelids", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the side of the head"}, {"looks_like": "short hooked beak-like mouth with a pointed upper tip", "part": "mouth", "where": "at the front tip of the head"}, {"looks_like": "thick wrinkled scaly neck", "part": "neck", "where": "between the head and the front opening of the shell"}, {"looks_like": "large domed hard shell with polygonal brown and tan striped scutes", "part": "shell", "where": "covering the middle of the back and sides of the body"}, {"looks_like": "dense shaggy curly brown sheep-like wool", "part": "fur", "where": "covering the top of the shell and hanging over its edges"}, {"looks_like": "four thick stout reptilian legs covered in small round scales with larger pointed scales on the front pair", "part": "legs", "where": "two at the front under the shell and two at the rear under the shell, supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "broad blunt feet with short conical claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "short tapered pointed scaly tail", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body under the back edge of the shell"}, {"looks_like": "small pebbly reptile scales and larger overlapping pointed scutes", "part": "scales", "where": "on the head, neck, legs, feet and tail"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
